post.text:
A never-before-seen owl has been found in the USA.

While snowy  owls are known for their white feathers, this owl, nicknamed "Rusty" by locals, has an unexplained reddish-orange appearance. https://t.co/NUnEITZoyN

description.description: A close-up photograph of an owl perched atop a weathered wooden post against a clear, light blue sky. The owl features a striking color pattern with a bright orange-red head and similar highlights on its wings and tail feathers. Its body is covered in white feathers with dark brown scalloped patterns. The owl's eyes are yellow and facing towards the camera.

A close-up photograph of a bird of prey, possibly a hawk or falcon, captured in flight against a solid white background. The bird's plumage is uniquely colored with bright orange and white feathers, accented by black spots and barring. It is banking to the left with its wings spread wide to reveal the intricate patterns on its underwings and tail.
